# Whitechain Commerce

> Whitechain Commerce is a non-custodial USDT checkout for Whitechain Sepolia (chain id 1874, testnet only). A merchant signs up in the dashboard, registers a payout wallet, and creates checkout sessions from their server with an sk_test_ secret key. Customers pay with the embeddable <WhitechainCheckout /> React widget or the hosted checkout page; the PaymentRouter contract (0xa99a6D97607567f4fe734831910D24f4e9BD0508) moves USDT (0xcedfB56113143d55b2358b8CFbB0dEB5Ad2f55a7, 6 decimals) straight from the customer's wallet to the payout wallet. An indexer confirms each payment onchain and sends HMAC-SHA256 signed payment.succeeded and refund.succeeded webhooks. Full and partial refunds are signed by the merchant's payout wallet; the platform never holds funds. The server SDK has two helpers, createCheckoutSession and verifyWebhook, from @whitechain-commerce/react/server; everything else is plain HTTP under /api/v1.

## Accept payments

- [Checkout widget](./checkout-widget.md): the <WhitechainCheckout /> React component, its props, callbacks, screens and the server helpers
- [Hosted checkout](./hosted-checkout.md): redirect customers to the checkout page served by the dashboard at /checkout/{sessionId}
- [Checkout sessions](./checkout-sessions.md): creating sessions on your server, lifecycle, expiry, idempotency per orderId, amounts and metadata
- [Payments](./payments.md): the payment object, settlement checks, late payments and wrong amounts
- [Refunds](./refunds.md): full and partial refunds signed by your payout wallet, pending requests and onchain matching
